name: Ipamorelin
effects: Selective ghrelin/GHS-R1a receptor agonist — stimulates GH release without increasing cortisol or prolactin
Selective GH pulse: minimal effect on ACTH, cortisol — cleaner profile than GHRP-2/6
Promotes IGF-1 increase; muscle gain, fat loss, improved sleep quality reported
Typically dosed 200–300 µg, 1–3x daily (before bed or fasted)
Often combined with CJC-1295 for amplified GH pulses
Well tolerated; minor: flushing, tingling at injection site
Not FDA approved; banned by WADA
